title: pm-dispatch finding: the landing window ends at MERGED — no release-aftercare duties (placement re-draw physics, tourniquet rule for replayed state, orphaned-loop resumption)
body:
## Gap

pm-dispatch's landing window ends at MERGED (入队跟到 MERGED、两读). Nothing in SKILL.md or the references covers **what a PM owes AFTER a production release rolls** — grep for 部署后/发版后/placement across the skill returns nothing. Two days of cloud release operations (v1.24.0 → v1.28.0, epic cloud#1521) hit the same three post-release traps repeatedly, each currently living only in one operator's memory.

## Evidence (all from cloud, 2026-08-21/23)

1. **Fleet rolls re-draw container placement, and bad draws eat the whole perf budget.** Every tagged deploy re-drew Cloudflare container placement; v1.27.0 landed the control plane in Houston (35.9ms/leg ≈ ~870ms/request vs the ≤200ms gate), v1.28.0 landed Atlanta (~18ms). Recovery has a written protocol with two non-obvious physics: placement follows the WAKER (re-rolls woken from a California operator machine drew Houston repeatedly; waking via a us-east CI runner drew Ashburn first try), and MEASURING contaminates the next draw (a probe mid-swap becomes the new instance's waker). Protocol: rollout → zero operator HTTP → wake via us-east runner (`gh workflow run keep-warm`) → read the CF instances API for the city → only then measure.
2. **Hand-fixes to state that a replay layer owns get silently reverted.** The SSO outage remediation (cloud#1591) hand-flipped `sys_oauth_application.token_endpoint_auth_method` rows; a pre-fix deploy's reseed reverted them TWICE before the fix landed in the seed itself (cloud#1597). Rule worth stating: a DB hand-fix is a tourniquet — before applying one, name WHO replays that state and WHEN (seed, reseed, migration, boot binder), and treat the replay-layer fix as the real card. Corollary: the fixed code must ship before the next event that replays the state, or the outage re-opens.
3. **Interrupted long-running loops leave production in an unknown intermediate state.** A backgrounded re-draw loop orphaned by a session restart left prod's control plane parked on its WORST draw (Houston, 40.8ms/leg) for hours. On resume, the first action must be re-reading live state, never continuing from the loop's last known intent.

## Suggested shape (for the skills seat to judge)

A short "release aftercare" section or reference page: after any prod roll — (a) placement/latency reading against the perf gate, with the waker-bias re-draw protocol; (b) one real user-path probe (the SSO outage hid for 5 weeks behind health-only monitoring); (c) the tourniquet rule for live-state hand-fixes; (d) orphaned-loop resumption = re-read reality first. Also a candidate honesty clause: when a later measurement falsifies an assertion made in a merged PR body (the cloud#1589 "SQL DEFAULT backfills existing rows" claim), the correction gets posted to the card, not just known privately.

Origin: maintainer directive 2026-08-23 「评估哪些需要更新cloud项目经理skills的，提交issue」. Details/receipts: cloud#1521 comments (release logs), cloud#1591/#1597, cloud#1586.
